messages:
maya: Heads up — Deploybot quarantined the payments image for staging: `redwood/payments:staging` (digest sha256:abcd1234...) citing "provenance TTL expired". Change window at 18:30 UTC, we need a plan.

deploybot: [automated] publish blocked: provenance_attestation_ttl_expired (attestation_timestamp=1710000000, now=1735550000). quarantine_id=q-4b7. Suggested actions: re-attest, republish, or pin digest.

sam: ping @eng-infra — did we rotate cosign keys recently? I saw a key-rotation job this morning.

alejandro: We rotated the cosign key at ~03:10 UTC. Old attestations should still be valid for the TTL window (30d). Curious why TTL is hit — maybe attestation timestamp is wrong.

liz: quick grep on the image metadata shows build_timestamp=1710000000 on that artifact — one builder node had NTP drift earlier in the month, might be the culprit.

maya: Ok options: 1) quick rebuild and republish (safer), 2) manual pin previous working digest in deploy config to unblock canary quickly, 3) attempt re-attestation without rebuild (risky). Thoughts?

ronan: For the imminent change window, pinning is fastest. We can schedule a proper rebuild immediately after.

sam: I can apply a manual pin and unquarantine. Will also add an explicit expire time for the pin. Command I'll run: `/deploybot pin-image redwood/payments@sha256:ef12beef --expires 2024-12-01`

maya: Please put a short release note entry when you pin: "hotfix: temporary pin due to attestation timestamp skew; full rebuild scheduled"

liz: Agree with pin+rebuild. Re-attestation without rebuild bypasses traceability — not ideal. Security should be looped in.

deploybot: [system] Manual pin requested by sam @1735550300. Action: apply_pin -> redwood/payments@sha256:ef12beef; quarantine q-4b7 set to unquarantined_by=sam; audit_id=a-909. Canary rollout resumed.

maya: Canary pods now 2/2 healthy, traffic slowly ramping :thumbsup:

alejandro: Kicking off CI rebuild: `pipelines/payments/rebuild-staging` triggered. ETA ~25m.

sam: I'll update the release notes and create a short postmortem entry. Marking as release-note-tag: manifest/attestation.

maya: Filing follow-up infra ticket INFRA-1423: "Validate builder node NTP + image build_timestamp consistency". Assigning to @eng-infra.

liz: Also add a short blurb to the security channel so they can audit the manual pin action.

ronan: Thanks all — spinning this into the rollback/rollback-criteria doc: if attestation TTL triggers in prod we'll prefer pinned revert + rebuild over re-attestation.

maya: Sounds good. Closing thread once postmortem + release note are up.
